notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0731 alpha-b151432
notes.content: [h1]Improvements to the Vehicle Assembly Building[/h1][p]We have improved the functionality of the Vehicle Assembly Building where rockets are assembled.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/6543256b36022f6a73adeb4a4188ece570c5761f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Registering user texture images[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/8d75e43cb9e05354a992aeec265d1242d3c06f31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can register your favorite texture images from the “Texture” menu at the top of the screen.[/p][p]The texture images registered here can be applied to rocket parts.[/p][p][/p][h3]Parts Editor[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d3831b7edd9e78ee3887875072eff72d3e3c35f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Right-clicking on a rocket part opens the Parts Editor. In the Parts Editor, you can change the color, texture, scale, and other properties.[/p][p][/p][h3]Linear Symmetry Placement[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/a3d21101ddf914dda8a167b4d77144314a496e00.png"][/img][/p][p]By selecting options such as ×3 or ×4 from the top of the screen, you can duplicate and place parts in linear symmetry.[/p]

tags.feature: You can register your favorite texture images from the “Texture” menu at the top of the screen.
The texture images registered here can be applied to rocket parts.
Right-clicking on a rocket part opens the Parts Editor. In the Parts Editor, you can change the color, texture, scale, and other properties.
By selecting options such as ×3 or ×4 from the top of the screen, you can duplicate and place parts in linear symmetry.

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0703 alpha-b165837:Hot fix
notes.content: [h1]A version with bug fixes will be released.[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/79ea80cca4aef707ca25f4835f0b51350326468c.jpg"][/img][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would crash when placing celestial bodies in the debug console.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera parallel movement in VAB.[/p][/*][*][p]We have enabled parallel movement of the camera by clicking the middle mouse button and dragging.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now select the era.[/p][/*][/olist]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where the game would crash when placing celestial bodies in the debug console.

tags.feature: - We have enabled parallel movement of the camera by clicking the middle mouse button and dragging.
- You can now select the era.

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0630 alpha-b214915
notes.content: [list][*][p]We made it possible to assemble rockets in the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) and launch them.[/p][/*][*][p]We made it possible to accelerate time during rocket launches.[/p][/*][*][p]We improved the freedom of camera operation at the rocket launch site.[/p][/*][*][p]We made it possible to save rocket launch parameters for each rocket.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/a934f9ecf0d0531331657b6eaab6cc8e23499a6b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d906252a108befb821203a549173d9eeafa03bff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: We made it possible to assemble rockets in the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) and launch them.
We made it possible to accelerate time during rocket launches.
We improved the freedom of camera operation at the rocket launch site.
We made it possible to save rocket launch parameters for each rocket.

notes.title: A playable demo will be released on December 12th.
notes.content:
A playable demo will be released on December 12th.

This game is still under development and does not represent the final quality of the product.
In this demo, you will be able to experience the following
[list]
[*] The position of each celestial body at a specified date and time can be obtained.
[*] View the spacecraft flying in orbit.
[*] Attitude control and orbit change of the spacecraft.
[*] You can launch a preset rocket. In the commercial version, you can launch rockets of your own design.
[/list]
